_about: The one original-to-port mapping. Every other file holds the original's figures in its own units: screen space (-0.5..0.5 is the screen height) and per frame (it had no time step). Core multiplies lengths by lengthScale and converts per-frame figures at framesPerSecond (BIBLE D9), here and nowhere else (OriginalSpace).
_scale: lengthScale 9: the original's screen height (1.0, -0.5..0.5) is the arena's 9 world-unit height. The original ran 4:3 (Camera.vb PerspectiveFovLH aspect 4/3, 640x480 form), so its screen was 1.333 wide; the 16 x 9 arena is wider, and x uses the same scale (no stretch), so the extra width is just more room at the sides.
